What if you could change color like an octopus?
Meet the octopus. Master of disguise.
Its skin has thousands of tiny color sacs.
Red, yellow, brown, black. Like paint bags.
Tiny muscles stretch them open. Color appears!
Its brain does it in a split second.
It can grow bumps and spikes, too.
Sand? Coral? Rock? It becomes them all.
The weird part? It's probably colorblind!
Its skin may even sense light itself.
Normal you on the lawn? Easy to spot.
Striped grass? Now you're striped too.
Lean on the house? You become the wall.
So... where would you hide first?
